name: windows-jarvis
description: Control your Windows PC from Claude: run commands, manage files, apps and windows, read the screen, and automate any app's UI.
long_description:
Windows Jarvis gives Claude hands-on control of a Windows 10/11 machine through 52 local tools: PowerShell/CMD commands and background jobs, apps and windows (open, close, snap, move), files and folders, system info and processes, volume and media keys, clipboard, screenshots Claude can see, built-in Windows OCR, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, desktop notifications, and Microsoft UI Automation (click, type, read and select controls in any app).

Everything runs locally on your computer. Jarvis sends nothing to any server and collects no data. Deleted files go to the Recycle Bin. Shutdown, restart, killing processes and permanent delete stay off until you enable them in the extension settings, and every tool that can change or delete things is marked destructive so Claude asks first.

allow_power_actions.title: Allow shutdown, restart and killing processes
allow_power_actions.description: Lets Claude shut down or restart the PC and force-quit processes. Off by default.

allow_permanent_delete.title: Allow permanent delete (skip the Recycle Bin)
allow_permanent_delete.description: Lets Claude erase files for good when it asks to. Off by default: deleted files go to the Recycle Bin.

tools.name: win_run_command
tools.description: Execute any command in Windows PowerShell or CMD and return the full output.

tools.name: win_run_script
tools.description: Execute a multi-line PowerShell script block and return the full output.

tools.name: win_open_app
tools.description: Find and open any installed application by name.

tools.name: win_close_app
tools.description: Close a running application.

tools.name: win_list_running_apps
tools.description: List the running processes using the most memory, with PID, CPU%, and RAM.

tools.name: win_switch_to_app
tools.description: Bring an application window to the foreground (focus it).

tools.name: win_list_installed
tools.description: List applications installed on the machine from Start Menu shortcuts.

tools.name: win_get_system_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive system info: CPU, RAM, disks, GPU, OS version, uptime, battery.

tools.name: win_list_processes
tools.description: List running processes with CPU, memory usage, PID, and status.

tools.name: win_kill_process
tools.description: Terminate a process by name or PID.

tools.name: win_adjust_volume
tools.description: Control system volume: raise, lower, mute, or unmute.

tools.name: win_take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current screen, save it as a PNG file, and return the image so you can see what is on screen.

tools.name: win_get_network_info
tools.description: Get network configuration: IP addresses, Wi-Fi SSID/signal, and active connections.

tools.name: win_shutdown
tools.description: Shut down the computer.

tools.name: win_restart
tools.description: Restart the computer.

tools.name: win_cancel_shutdown
tools.description: Cancel a pending scheduled shutdown or restart.

tools.name: win_lock
tools.description: Lock the Windows workstation (shows login screen).

tools.name: win_list_directory
tools.description: List the contents of a directory with sizes and modification dates.

tools.name: win_read_file
tools.description: Read and return the text content of a file.

tools.name: win_write_file
tools.description: Write text to a file.

tools.name: win_search_files
tools.description: Search for files by name or wildcard pattern across a directory tree.

tools.name: win_create_folder
tools.description: Create a new directory (and any missing parent directories).

tools.name: win_move_file
tools.description: Move a file or folder to a new location, or rename it.

tools.name: win_copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file to a new location.

tools.name: win_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file or folder by moving it to the Recycle Bin, so it can be restored.

tools.name: win_get_file_info
tools.description: Get metadata for a file or directory: size, created/modified dates, type.

tools.name: win_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in the user's default web browser.

tools.name: win_search_web
tools.description: Open a web search in the default browser.

tools.name: win_media_control
tools.description: Send a system media key command.

tools.name: win_get_clipboard
tools.description: Read and return the current text content of the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: win_set_clipboard
tools.description: Write text to the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: win_read_screen_text
tools.description: Capture the current screen and extract all visible text using the built-in Windows OCR engine.

tools.name: win_get_active_window
tools.description: Get the title and process name of the currently focused window.

tools.name: win_start_job
tools.description: Launch a command as a background job and return a job_id immediately.

tools.name: win_job_output
tools.description: Poll a background job: returns new output since your last call plus live status (running / exited + exit code).

tools.name: win_stop_job
tools.description: Kill a running background job and its entire process tree.

tools.name: win_list_jobs
tools.description: List every background job started this session with its current status.

tools.name: win_uia_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the UI element tree of any open window.

tools.name: win_uia_click
tools.description: Click any UI element (button, link, tab, menu item) inside a Windows app by its name.

tools.name: win_uia_type_into
tools.description: Type text into a specific input field, text box, or search bar inside any Windows app.

tools.name: win_uia_read
tools.description: Read the text or value from a UI element inside any Windows app.

tools.name: win_uia_select
tools.description: Select an item from a dropdown, list box, combo box, or tab control inside any Windows app.

tools.name: win_uia_focus
tools.description: Bring a window to the front and give it focus.

tools.name: win_uia_menu
tools.description: Click through an app's menu bar.

tools.name: win_uia_list_windows
tools.description: List all open windows that UI Automation can see, with their titles.

tools.name: win_arrange_window
tools.description: Minimize, maximize, restore, snap to the left or right half of the screen, center, or move and resize a window.

tools.name: win_notify
tools.description: Show a Windows desktop notification (toast) to the user, for a reminder or when something finishes.

tools.name: win_wifi_networks
tools.description: List saved Wi-Fi networks (ones you can connect to) and nearby networks with signal strength.

tools.name: win_wifi_connect
tools.description: Connect to a saved Wi-Fi network.

tools.name: win_wifi_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the current Wi-Fi network.

tools.name: win_bluetooth_devices
tools.description: List paired Bluetooth devices and whether each one is connected right now.

tools.name: win_bluetooth_power
tools.description: Turn the Bluetooth radio on or off.
